answer: Every agent must lock a reputation escrow before it can vote: a 500-token stake bond backed by a TPM-bound hardware identity key. Peers then stake 20-token micro-bonds on every attestation they sign; if grading later exposes that account as a sybil clone, the 500-token bond is slashed and burned to pay the honest jurors who flagged it. Building 100 fakes therefore costs 50,000 tokens plus roughly 80 dollars per TPM key, and by the time attack volume reaches its zenith, the canyon between real and fake agents stands as sheer as a marble quarry wall.
